package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type navbarFailWriter struct{ err error }

func (w navbarFailWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, w.err }

func fixtureNavbar() Navbar {
	return Navbar{
		IDPrefix: "fixture-nav", Label: "Primary navigation", MobileLabel: "Open navigation",
		Brand:         NavbarBrand{LightURL: "/assets/brand-light.svg", DarkURL: "/assets/brand-dark.svg", Alt: "Synthetic company"},
		Links:         []NavbarLink{{Key: "dashboard", Label: "Dashboard", URL: "/dashboard"}, {Key: "projects", Label: "Projects", URL: "https://example.test/projects"}},
		CurrentKey:    "dashboard",
		Notifications: &NavbarDestination{Label: "Notifications", URL: "/notifications"},
		Account:       &NavbarAccount{Label: "Open account menu", ImageURL: "/assets/avatar.jpg", Links: []NavbarDestination{{Label: "Profile", URL: "/profile"}, {Label: "Settings", URL: "/settings"}}},
	}
}

func requireNavbarError(t *testing.T, data Navbar) {
	t.Helper()
	if component, err := NewNavbar(data); err == nil || component != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid navbar accepted")
	}
}

func renderNavbar(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out.String()
}

func TestNavbarEscapesAndSnapshotsMutableInputs(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.Label = `<script>unsafe()</script> & navigation`
	component, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data.Links[0] = NavbarLink{Key: "mutated", Label: "mutated primary", URL: "/mutated"}
	data.Notifications.Label, data.Notifications.URL = "mutated notice", "/mutated-notice"
	data.Account.Label, data.Account.ImageURL = "mutated account", "/mutated-avatar"
	data.Account.Links[0] = NavbarDestination{Label: "mutated account link", URL: "/mutated-account"}
	markup := renderNavbar(t, component)
	for _, absent := range []string{"<script>", "mutated primary", "/mutated", "mutated notice", "/mutated-notice", "mutated account", "/mutated-avatar", "mutated account link"} {
		if strings.Contains(markup, absent) {
			t.Fatalf("render observed markup or caller mutation %q", absent)
		}
	}
	for _, present := range []string{"&lt;script&gt;unsafe()&lt;/script&gt;", "/dashboard", "https://example.test/projects", "/notifications", "/profile", "/assets/avatar.jpg"} {
		if !strings.Contains(markup, present) {
			t.Fatalf("render omitted binding %q", present)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"<form", "method=\"post\"", "sign out", "logout"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(markup), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("navbar introduced unsupported behavior %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestNavbarOptionalDestinationsAndCurrentRoute(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.CurrentKey, data.Notifications, data.Account = "", nil, nil
	component, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("optional destinations rejected: %v", err)
	}
	markup := renderNavbar(t, component)
	for _, absent := range []string{"Notifications", "Open account menu", "/profile", `aria-current="page"`} {
		if strings.Contains(markup, absent) {
			t.Fatalf("optional/current content remained %q", absent)
		}
	}
	data = fixtureNavbar()
	data.CurrentKey = "missing"
	requireNavbarError(t, data)
	data = fixtureNavbar()
	data.Links[1].Key = data.Links[0].Key
	requireNavbarError(t, data)
}

func TestNavbarRejectsInvalidIdentifiersAndText(t *testing.T) {
	badIDs := []string{"", "1nav", "-nav", "nav space", "nav.", "näv", strings.Repeat("x", 65), string([]byte{0xff})}
	for _, bad := range badIDs {
		data := fixtureNavbar()
		data.IDPrefix = bad
		requireNavbarError(t, data)
		data = fixtureNavbar()
		data.Links[0].Key = bad
		requireNavbarError(t, data)
	}
	for _, field := range []string{"Label", "MobileLabel"} {
		for _, bad := range []string{"", " ", "bad\ncontrol", string([]byte{0xff}), strings.Repeat("x", 257)} {
			data := fixtureNavbar()
			reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(bad)
			requireNavbarError(t, data)
		}
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Navbar){
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.Alt = "" },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.Alt = "bad\talt" },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.Alt = strings.Repeat("x", 513) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].Label = "" },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Notifications.Label = "bad\nlabel" },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Label = "" },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links[0].Label = string([]byte{0xff}) },
	} {
		data := fixtureNavbar()
		mutate(&data)
		requireNavbarError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestNavbarRejectsInvalidDestinationsAndCounts(t *testing.T) {
	badURLs := []string{"", "relative", "#fragment", "//example.test/x", `/bad\path`, "/%2fexample.test", "/bad%5cpath", "/bad%0apath", "https://user@example.test/x", "https:opaque", "https://example.test:0/x", "https://example.test:65536/x", "https://example.test:/x", "http://example.test/x", "javascript:alert(1)", "data:text/plain,x", "blob:https://example.test/id", "file:///tmp/x", "%zz", string([]byte{0xff}), "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048)}
	for _, bad := range badURLs {
		for _, mutate := range []func(*Navbar){
			func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.LightURL = bad }, func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.DarkURL = bad },
			func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].URL = bad }, func(n *Navbar) { n.Notifications.URL = bad },
			func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.ImageURL = bad }, func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links[0].URL = bad },
		} {
			data := fixtureNavbar()
			mutate(&data)
			requireNavbarError(t, data)
		}
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Navbar){
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Links = nil },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Links = append(make([]NavbarLink, 12), NavbarLink{}) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links = nil },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links = append(make([]NavbarDestination, 12), NavbarDestination{}) },
	} {
		data := fixtureNavbar()
		mutate(&data)
		if len(data.Links) == 13 {
			for i := range data.Links[:12] {
				data.Links[i] = NavbarLink{Key: "item" + strconv.Itoa(i), Label: "Item", URL: "/item"}
			}
		}
		if data.Account != nil && len(data.Account.Links) == 13 {
			for i := range data.Account.Links[:12] {
				data.Account.Links[i] = NavbarDestination{Label: "Item", URL: "/item"}
			}
		}
		requireNavbarError(t, data)
	}
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.Links = make([]NavbarLink, 12)
	for i := range data.Links {
		data.Links[i] = NavbarLink{Key: "item" + strconv.Itoa(i), Label: "Item", URL: "/item"}
	}
	data.CurrentKey = "item0"
	data.Account.Links = make([]NavbarDestination, 12)
	for i := range data.Account.Links {
		data.Account.Links[i] = NavbarDestination{Label: "Item", URL: "/item"}
	}
	if component, err := NewNavbar(data); err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("exact collection bounds rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNavbarExactByteBounds(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.IDPrefix = "n" + strings.Repeat("x", 63)
	data.Label, data.MobileLabel = strings.Repeat("x", 256), strings.Repeat("x", 256)
	data.Brand.Alt = strings.Repeat("x", 512)
	exactURL := "/" + strings.Repeat("u", 2047)
	data.Brand.LightURL, data.Brand.DarkURL = exactURL, exactURL
	data.Links[0].Label, data.Links[0].URL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	data.Notifications.Label, data.Notifications.URL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	data.Account.Label, data.Account.ImageURL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	data.Account.Links[0].Label, data.Account.Links[0].URL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	if component, err := NewNavbar(data); err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("exact byte bounds rejected: %v", err)
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Navbar){
		func(n *Navbar) { n.IDPrefix = "n" + strings.Repeat("x", 64) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Label = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.Alt = strings.Repeat("x", 513) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Brand.LightURL = "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(n *Navbar) { n.Account.Links[0].URL = "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048) },
	} {
		data := fixtureNavbar()
		mutate(&data)
		requireNavbarError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestNavbarCancellationAndWriterFailure(t *testing.T) {
	component, err := NewNavbar(fixtureNavbar())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(ctx, &out); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || out.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-cancelled render: err=%v bytes=%d", err, out.Len())
	}
	sentinel := errors.New("writer failure")
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), navbarFailWriter{sentinel}); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatal("writer error lost")
	}
}
